title: 第1722章明经魁首我稳了第1721章李文轩的忐忑什么高相有请
slug: 我最强毒士女帝直呼活阎王
lines: 轰！
这四个字一出。
雅间内瞬间安静。
王景行手里的酒杯都差点没拿稳。
“什么？”
“高相？”
“定国公府的那位高相？”
王景行一脸震惊，忍不住的追问道。
陈胜点头道。
“不错。”
“高相说这段时日六科取仕事务繁忙，未能尽地主之谊。”
“如今御前终审已毕，他总算得空。”
“久闻江南李氏李文轩公子之名，又念着两家多少有些旧亲，故请李公子与李姑娘今晚酉时赴定国公府用晚膳。”
陈胜说完，又十分和善的道：“陈胜此来只是先给高相传个话。”
“高相说了，不急着接人，李公子与李姑娘可从容准备。”
轰隆！
李文轩整个人都愣住了。
高阳亲自相邀？
而且是在放榜前一日？还是晚上去用膳？
王景行的眼神瞬间变了。
不只是他。
雅间外，不少学子听到动静，也全都伸长了脖子。
“高相亲自请李文轩？还是放榜的前一日？”
“这是什么意思？”
“还能是什么意思？御前终审刚毕，高相便派人来请，这难道还不明显？”
“李文轩莫不是已经中了？”
“何止中了？只怕名次还极高！”
“难道是……明经魁首？”
嘶！
这一句落下，周围瞬间响起一片倒吸凉气的声音。
李文轩的心，也忍不住猛地跳了一下。
他努力压下心头的激动与狂喜，朝陈胜拱手。
“高相相邀，文轩不敢辞。”
“劳烦陈统领回禀高相，今晚文轩定携表妹准时拜访。”
陈胜笑着道：“李公子客气。”
“高相还说两家既有旧亲，李公子大可不必拘束。”
说完。
陈胜直接转身离去。
但他这话一出，周围学子的眼神顿时更加不对了。
不必拘束？
高相何时对人这么客气过？
此刻。
content_en:
boom!
As soon as these four words came out.
The private room fell silent for a moment.
Wang Jingxing almost lost his grip on the wine glass in his hand.
"What?"
"Gao Xiang?"
"That high minister in Dingguo Palace?"
Wang Jingxing looked shocked and couldn't help but ask.
Chen Sheng nodded.
"Not bad."
"Xiang Gao said that during this period, the Sixth Section was busy with official recruitment matters, and he was unable to fulfill his duties as a landlord."
"Now that the final trial in front of the imperial court has been completed, he is finally free."
"I have heard about the name of Mr. Li Wenxuan of the Jiangnan Li family for a long time, and also remember that the two families are somewhat old relatives, so I invite Mr. Li and Miss Li to have dinner at the Dingguo Duke's Mansion at midnight tonight."
After Chen Sheng finished speaking, he said very kindly: "Chen Sheng is here just to convey a message to Mr. Gao first."
"Prime Minister Gao said there is no rush to pick up people. Mr. Li and Miss Li can take their time to prepare."
Boom!
Li Wenxuan was stunned.
Gao Yang invited him personally?
And it was the day before the results were released? Or go for dinner in the evening?
Wang Jingxing's eyes changed instantly.
It's not just him.
Outside the private room, many students stretched their necks when they heard the noise.
"Prime Minister Gao personally invited Li Wenxuan? Or was it the day before the results were released?"
"What does this mean?"
"What else could it mean? Just after the final trial in front of the imperial court, the high minister sent someone to invite him. Isn't it obvious?"
"Could it be that Li Wenxuan has already been hit?"
"More than just winning? I'm afraid the ranking will be extremely high!"
"Could it be...the leader of Ming Jing?"
Hiss!
As soon as this sentence fell, there was a gasp of cold air all around.
Li Wenxuan's heart couldn't help but beat suddenly.
He tried hard to suppress the excitement and ecstasy in his heart, and handed over to Chen Sheng.
"The high minister invited us, but Wenxuan didn't dare to say goodbye."
"I'd like to trouble Commander Chen to report back to the Prime Minister. Wenxuan and his cousin will visit on time tonight."
Chen Sheng smiled and said: "Young Master Li, you are polite."
"Xiang Gao also said that since the two families are old relatives, Mr. Li doesn't need to be restrained."
Finished.
Chen Sheng turned around and left directly.
But as soon as he said these words, the eyes of the surrounding students suddenly became even more wrong.
No need to be restrained?
When has a high minister ever been so polite to someone?
now.
title_en: Chapter 1722: I am the leader of the Ming Dynasty. Chapter 1721: Li Wenxuan is worried about the invitation from the high minister.
